name: Communing (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
Communing abilities are about gaining from predictive or prognostication abilities.

Commune (Su)

You can use your connection to your force of nature to see patterns that can reveal the mysteries of the future.

You may, when communing with your force of nature for spells and primal points, predict the future. You may expend 1 primal point you just regained to select one of the benefits below for the next 24 hours or until you next commune with your force of nature.

Prediction: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 your class level (minimum +1) on initiative checks. Reflex saves and AC vs. traps, and Perception checks to notice ambushes.
Competence: You gain a competence bonus equal to 1/4 your class level (minimum +1) on a skill chosen when communing. In addition to the two options above, you gain an additional option based on your force of nature as shown below:
Fauna: You gain uncanny dodge as the barbarian special ability. If you have uncanny dodge from another source, this does not become improved uncanny dodge.
Flames: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 your class level to initiative checks, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when on any desert, or hot climate-based terrain, including the plane of fire but not in urban areas.
Land: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 your class level to initiative checks, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when on any land-based terrain, including underground but not in urban areas.
Ocean: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 their class level to Initiative checks, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), Perception, Swim and Survival checks when in or around any water-based terrain.
Rime: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 your class level to initiative checks, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when on any mountains, or cold climate-based terrain, including the cold extraplanar areas but not in urban areas.
Sky: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 your class level to Initiative checks, Fly, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), Perception, and Survival checks when exposed to the open sky (e.g. not in a building, under dense forest cover, or underground).
Verdant: You gain an insight bonus equal to 1/4 your class level on initiative checks, Knowledge (geography), Knowledge (nature), Stealth, and Survival checks in an area with plentiful plant life.
Burst of Insight (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): commune primal ability.

You can use your insight granted by communing with your force of nature to grant a sudden revelation that may turn the tide of a battle or the situation at hand.

This ability may be used as an immediate action granting a benefit based on the communing type used as shown below. Once this ability is activated, the benefit from the commune ends.

Prediction: You gain the effects of the spell augury. At 17th level, this becomes the spell divination.
Competence: You may extend your bonus to attack rolls, all other skill checks, ability checks or saving throws for 1 round per class level.
Fauna: You gain the benefits of improved uncanny dodge for 1 minute per class level.
Flames: You may extend the communing bonus to AC as long as you or your attacker are exposed to an open flame or ongoing fire damage for 1 minute per class level.
Land: You may extend the communing bonus to AC as long as you or your attacker are touching the ground for 1 minute per class level.
Ocean: You may extend the communing bonus to AC as long as you or your attacker are touching the a body of water for 1 minute per class level.
Rime: You may extend the communing bonus to AC as long as you or your attacker are exposed to ice or snow or ongoing cold damage for 1 minute per class level.
Sky: You may extend the communing bonus to AC as long as you or your attacker are airborne for 1 minute per class level.
Verdant: You may extend the communing bonus to AC against plant creatures or if you are considered a plant creature, for 1 minute per class level.
Commune, Shared (Su)

Prerequisite(s): commune primal ability.

You can share your insight with your allies. You grant the benefits of your commune primal ability to all allies within 30 feet, for as long as it is active. If the burst of insight primal ability is used, allies within 30 feet gain the benefits of the burst of insight.
